law_text: Pedestrians shall move whenever practicable upon the right half of crosswalks.

topic_inventory.exact-text: Pedestrians shall move whenever practicable upon the right half of crosswalks.
topic_inventory.pedestrian: Only a person afoot is the subject of this selected assignment.
topic_inventory.crosswalk: Qualified crosswalk geometry and pedestrian access must be read back, not inferred from a travel task.
topic_inventory.right_half: Right is relative to each pedestrian crossing direction; opposing approaches swap geometric halves.
topic_inventory.whenever_practicable: Practicability remains a contextual judgment; retain obstacles, available space, signals and participants without a numeric legal cutoff.
